title: More maps in rotation?

replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body: The problem is players are quite inexpert at making Walls YMLs (and there's nothing to blame them for since it is hard to do) and us Map Devs, even if provided with a YML, must test them in order to know if it works, and testing Walls maps with one person at time is quite hard (because as you know you need atleast 1 player in each team to prevent the server from automatically deciding the winner and change to cycling phase. I find Walls maps the hardest to test and work with, but as soon as we can provide the community more maps for Walls, we'll work hard to make sure they run fine.

replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body: Yeah I do need people to test the maps, and I'll try to fix the YMLs, don't worry about that. I don't think the community can really help on the matter besides helping to test the maps from time to time. Let's say Sandstorm: Walls is buggy, I'd have to fix, update repository, test, end game, fix again, update repo again, test again, end again, repeat the process over and over until it works, it is quite hard and there's not that much submitted Walls maps that are accepted... I'll try to get some more Walls maps into rotations as soon as I can.
